name: Bakonyjákó (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bakonyjákó: a quartered blue, red and green shield with a fleur-de-lis, a patriarchal cross, a tree and a sheaf of grain, inscribed BAKONYJÁKÓ on a chief.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
